items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-04-23
items.q: No, that just was a song. ... I went in there one night and Blazer Boy was singing this thing. Oh, LaBerta, oh, LaBerta, don't you hear me calling you. And boy, that stuck with me, stuck with me. And so I went home and I wrote Lavinia.

ctx.x: Okay, there was another song called Lavinia. Lavinia.
Was that about a certain person? Lavinia.
